pages.title: Scooped from a Toilet
pages.text: After eating Dragon Breath Chili, use a non-wood toilet to turn it into a lava toilet.$(br2)Scoop it with a bucket to collect lava and clear the toilet.

pages.title: Using Lava
pages.text: Pour lava into an empty compooper to make a lava compooper, or use it for fluid reactions.$(br2)Water and lava together make cobblestone.
